libraryMaintenanceDialog.title: Library Maintenance
libraryMaintenanceDialog.intro: Maintenance actions can reconcile your library with disk or rewrite sidecar metadata for the entire library. These tools may change existing items and are intended for deliberate repair or synchronization work, not routine discovery.

guidance.title: Choose the outcome you want
guidance.description: Use the safe additive scan for routine discovery. Use Library Settings or Manage Directories for normal library changes. Come back to maintenance only when you deliberately want to repair or synchronize existing records.

confirm.sidecarExportMessage: Rewrite sidecar metadata files for all books in library {{ name }}? This may replace existing sidecar JSON contents with current Fable metadata.
confirm.sidecarBackupMessage: Create or refresh backup sidecar files for all books in library {{ name }}? This writes backup sidecar files across the library.
confirm.sidecarImportMessage: Import metadata from sidecar files for all books in library {{ name }}? This may overwrite current database metadata with sidecar values where they exist.

reconcile.title: Reconcile Library
reconcile.impact: Compare the library against current disk contents and update Fable shelves to match. This may remove missing-file entries, purge disallowed formats, restore matching items, attach newly discovered formats, and regenerate derived library data.
reconcile.acknowledge: I understand this updates existing library records and is not the same as a new-file-only scan.

sidecarExport.title: Export Sidecars
sidecarExport.impact: Rewrite .metadata.json files for all books in this library from the current Fable metadata. Use this when the database should become the source of truth for sidecar files.

sidecarBackup.title: Back Up Sidecars
sidecarBackup.impact: Create or refresh backup sidecar files across the library even when automatic sidecar writing is disabled. This writes backup metadata files without turning on ongoing automatic rewrites.

sidecarImport.title: Import Sidecars
sidecarImport.impact: Read existing .metadata.json files across the library and apply their metadata back into Fable. Use this when the sidecar files should become the source of truth for the database.

duplicateMerger.title: Find Duplicates
duplicateMerger.description: Review duplicate candidates with explicit scan scope before taking any follow-up action elsewhere.
duplicateMerger.scopeDescription: Keep duplicate detection bounded to the exact slice of the collection you want to inspect.
duplicateMerger.matchingDescription: Start with a preset, then widen or narrow the signals only if you need to.
duplicateMerger.presetStrictDescription: Only the strongest metadata matches. Best when you want the lowest-noise review list.
duplicateMerger.presetBalancedDescription: A practical default that combines identifier matches with title and author overlap.
duplicateMerger.presetAggressiveDescription: Also considers folder and filename similarity. Useful for cleanup passes, but expect more false positives.
duplicateMerger.presetCustomDescription: Use your own exact mix of signals.
duplicateMerger.reviewOnlyDescription: Delete and remove-from-library actions have been removed from duplicate review. You can now inspect candidates, open book details, and launch a reader for digital files without mutating any records.
